description_en: Before using large models or applications in Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, create an API key as an authentication credential
description_zh: 使用阿里云百炼的大模型或应用前，请先创建 API Key 作为鉴权凭证
kebab_example: aliyun maas create-api-key --workspace-id llm-y3kv9qctnlytgmga --description test --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateApiKey

parameters.help_en:
The workspace ID.

If you leave this parameter empty, the created API key is automatically assigned to the default workspace
parameters.help_zh:
业务空间 ID。

若不填写时，创建的API Key会自动归属于默认业务空间
parameters.name: workspace_id
